versions.changelog:
Initial release of the work-productivity-humanizer-remove-workflow-helper skill.

- Provides a workflow for revising AI-generated or generic text into natural, audience-appropriate writing.
- Emphasizes ethical clarity, factual accuracy, and preservation of author voice and intent.
- Offers minimal edits and stronger rewrites, with edit notes and voice guidelines when helpful.
- Flags unsupported or risky claims and ensures compliance with factual and legal requirements.
- Designed for writers, marketers, students, support teams, and skill authors seeking authentic, readable revisions.
